title: Onboard orbit-lite-4b v1.1: perf profiles, metadata, changelog automation
author: Aisha Khan
description:
Motivation: Add Orbit-Lite 4B v1.1 to the model registry with curated metadata, production performance profiles for common sequence-length buckets, and automated changelog/release-note generation so product and docs teams can track changes. This PR includes: metadata (model card, tokenizer, expected input/output shapes), perf profiles (latency & throughput benchmarks for 512/1024/2048 tokens on A100 and T4), and automation hooks that append a standardized entry to the model-registry changelog on merge.

Checklist:
- [x] Add model metadata JSON and model-card markdown with attribution and license
- [x] Generate performance profiles from benchmark-lab runs and include profiles YAML
- [x] Add changelog automation script entry and a test fixture for the release notes generator
- [x] Add sanity unit tests for metadata validation and schema conformance
- [x] Confirm CI passes on linux (x86) and ubuntu-latest images

Notes and context: Orbit-Lite 4B is a trimmed variant of Orbit that trades some accuracy for lower memory and better latency at small sequence lengths. v1.1 includes tokenizer fixes (whitespace handling) and a small embedding-normalization change; both are documented in the model card. Perf numbers were produced by the benchmark-lab harness (run id: bench/2026-02-15/orbit-lite-4b/v1.1) and validated against our quantization profiles. Changelog automation reuses the existing automation in /scripts/changelog-generator and adds a model-registry-specific template to ensure entries include model name, version, release date, perf summary, and a link to the model-card.

Potential follow-ups: add a smoke test that runs a small end-to-end sample through Redwood Serve (dedicated) to validate runtime-spec behavior under real batching; import rollout plan to allow canarying new model variants on dedicated clusters.

Related: ENG-2145 (perf onboarding), PM-402 (product announcement), infra/benchmarks:bench/2026-02-15.
